decisions.reason: Cloud transactional email sending builds directly on the firm's core email infrastructure knowledge, and its home-page prominence shows strategic commitment and good capacity to interpret and improve it.

Document capture and recognition extends the firm's document and message conversion expertise and has its own dedicated page, though OCR is a more distant knowledge domain that may need external cooperation.
Email-fax conversion is close to the firm's established messaging business, so it can readily assimilate customer feedback and refine the service.
Fax delivery optimization is an incremental feature resting on existing fax know-how, although it is only mentioned on the site and could later be folded into the core service.
Sandbox threat protection complements the firm's existing email security knowledge and serves growing demand, which justifies continued investment in learning.
Multi-engine virus scanning builds on established email filtering capabilities and fits the firm's security portfolio.
